propositions: PlanContext assembly silently swallows child-enumeration and per-child-fetch exceptions with bare `except Exception`, leaving `children` empty and flipping `has_children` to False
Container-scoped DET checks (p5_task_dag, p8_reviewability) are gated by `has_children` and return trivial PASS instead of reporting incompleteness when hierarchy load fails totally
Plan review produces unqualified clean PASS when ticket hierarchy was loaded incompletely, violating parent epic AC#4 that requires INDETERMINATE or an irrelevance exception

Five separate `finalize_verdict` call sites (precheck, coach, two recovery paths, one degrade path) do not consistently receive hierarchy-incompleteness signals because only precheck has direct access to real PlanContext; threading via coverage dict is incomplete or missing

The plan-review.yaml workflow does not pass `hierarchy_incomplete` and `hierarchy_incomplete_detail` as inputs to coach steps, so coach-path finalize_verdict always defaults the flags to False even when precheck detected failure

Schema and lint rules allow undeclared fields in det_coverage but require plan_review_precheck_output to be closed, making safe addition of new coverage flags contingent on schema update and YAML template editing
